name: Can I apply new stucco texture over existing stucco?

mainEntity.name: Can I apply new stucco texture over existing stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many cases, you can apply new stucco texture over existing stucco. The success of this process depends on the condition of the original stucco. The existing surface must be clean, structurally sound, and free of significant cracks or damage. Minor repairs may be necessary before applying a new finish coat. A professional assessment is recommended to ensure the substrate is suitable, preventing issues like delamination or uneven finishes. This approach can be a cost-effective way to update your home's exterior.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, new stucco texture can often be applied over existing stucco if the original surface is clean, sound, and properly prepared.
